notes: Original item IDs/names and nextexp values are client_verified; all reward formulas and probabilities here are designed.
Only victory after playback acknowledgement awards. Escape, defeat, draw and abort award zero.
Drop roll is derived once from server-generated encounter/battle IDs and persisted at admission; retries never reroll.
Bag full, unknown wallet, overflow or any failed channel rolls back the entire reward transaction; the admission plan remains pending for retry.
Existing growth policy controls automatic/manual level-up; no invented experience curve.
No double-time, team distribution, rare drops or death penalties are implied.
